grpc.marshalling: Orleans serializers are used through LatticeDataApiGrpcMarshallers.Create.

metadata.name: authorization
metadata.purpose: Request metadata carrying the credential token by default; the Bearer prefix is stripped when present.

metadata.name: lattice-active-tenant
metadata.purpose: Request metadata carrying the asserted active tenant by default.

metadata.name: lattice-denied-operation
metadata.purpose: Response trailer carrying the denied data operation on access-gate denial.

metadata.name: lattice-denied-reason
metadata.purpose: Response trailer carrying the access gate denial reason.

metadata.name: lattice-denied-subject
metadata.purpose: Response trailer carrying the denied subject id on access-gate denial.

metadata.name: lattice-denied-tree
metadata.purpose: Response trailer carrying the denied tree id on access-gate denial.

metadata.name: lattice-quota-current
metadata.purpose: Response trailer carrying the observed quota value when the breached dimension has a numeric ceiling.

metadata.name: lattice-quota-dimension
metadata.purpose: Response trailer carrying the breached quota dimension.

metadata.name: lattice-quota-limit
metadata.purpose: Response trailer carrying the configured quota ceiling when present.

metadata.name: lattice-quota-tree
metadata.purpose: Response trailer carrying the tree whose admission quota was breached.

auth.decision: The interceptor matches the data service prefix, optionally bypasses enforcement when RequireAuthorization is false, describes operation and target tree, and rejects false authorizer decisions with PermissionDenied before the facade runs.

retry.policy: Unary CRDT reads use no built-in client retry policy; absent or unreadable values return the empty value for their kind.

idempotency.basis: The operation reads a logical CRDT value and returns an empty value when absent or unreadable.

concurrency.rule: CRDT read verbs resolve existing trees only and return zero, false, empty, or null values for unregistered trees without materializing one.

retry.policy: Retry is safe when the same required operationId is reused with the same cross-tree batches.

idempotency.basis: The operationId is a required cross-tree idempotency key and every tree slice commits at one coordinator decision moment.

concurrency.rule: Every leg on every participating tree is authorized before apply and a denial aborts the whole cross-tree batch.

error_taxonomy.meaning: The request failed validation or carried an invalid continuation token.
The access gate denied the requested tree, operation, subject, or key span.
The request or authorization check was cancelled.
A typed OR-Map verb targeted a tree without the required map shape.
An operationId was reused with a different key or tree set.
The server logged an unexpected data-API failure and returned a generic fault.
An admission quota or sustained request-rate budget refused the operation.
The write shape does not match the replicated tree mode.
The call named an internal reserved tree namespace.
The tree is busy under storage back-pressure and the caller should back off.
The asserted active tenant could not be attributed or used for the target tree.
The coarse gRPC authorizer denied the call before it reached the facade.
